# CANDIDATE: VOL_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of low ATR (volatility compression), a breakout above the recent high with expanding volume signals a short‑term thrust. The edge exists because low volatility often precedes expansion, and volume-confirmed breakouts with EMA ribbon bias capture institutional participation while avoiding countertrend noise.

## Mechanism

Entry requires: ATR(14) < 0.5× its 20-period average AND price closes above the highest high of the last 20 bars AND volume > 1.3× average volume of those 20 bars AND EMA9 > EMA20. Regime filters: VIX between 15‑25, time after 10:00 EST, and price > 50‑EMA. Exit: stop at the low of the breakout bar, target at 2×ATR entry, runner trail using a premium‑stop of 15% of ATR.
